subject.title: [Feature]: Option to force-prepend an opening <think> tag for local reasoning models

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class default-off synthetic `<think>` opener option, or keep missing-delimiter behavior provider/model-owned through params and compatibility metadata?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but a new output-format/config contract is compatibility-sensitive and VISION.md favors lean core plus provider/plugin seams unless those seams are insufficient.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow core option
options.body: Add one documented default-off config path, wire it through runner/subscriber params, and prove no-tag plus native-tag cases for streaming and final output.

options.title: Prefer provider-owned controls first
options.body: Use existing provider params and compatibility metadata for model-specific thinking behavior, and add core delimiter synthesis only if maintainers confirm those seams cannot cover the observed models.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: Reject frontend-side delimiter synthesis and ask reporters to use provider/model prompt or request settings instead.

recommendation.title: Prefer provider-owned controls first
recommendation.body: Use existing provider params and compatibility metadata for model-specific thinking behavior, and add core delimiter synthesis only if maintainers confirm those seams cannot cover the observed models.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior maintainer review and recent reasoning/config history make steipete the best available owner for the config/output-format boundary decision.
